items: 🌞10W High-Efficiency Solar Panel🌞 - Our solar panel is designed with advanced monocrystalline silicon cells, delivering a higher energy conversion rate of up to 23%. With just 5 hours of sunlight, the solar powered fan is fully charged and ready to go! Prefer a quicker charge? Use the included USB cable to fully charge it in just 2 hours.

🌞30000mAh High-Capacity Battery🌞 - Say goodbye to low-quality camping fans! Our solar fan is equipped with a 30000mAh rechargeable battery, providing 16-48 hours of continuous cooling. It also supports working while charging, ensuring uninterrupted comfort.

🌞Quiet Yet Powerful Airflow🌞 - Experience the perfect balance of power and silence. Thanks to the latest brushless motor technology and ultra-thin fan blades, this rechargeable solar fan delivers strong airflow at a whisper-quiet <30db noise level. Keep your tent cool and comfortable without disturbing your peace.

🌞Super Bright LED Camping Light🌞 - Never be left in the dark! The solar fan features a built-in LED light with 3 brightness settings. Choose from a soft glow for a cozy ambiance or maximum brightness to light up your entire tent. The hook design allows you to hang it easily, saving space and adding convenience.

🌞Split Solar Fan with 1M Cable🌞 - ✅ Our detachable solar panel comes with a 1M cable, allowing you to place the panel in the sun while keeping the fan in the shade. This protects the battery from overheating and ensures safe, efficient charging.❌ Unlike all-in-one solar power fans, our design offers flexibility and safety, so you can enjoy cool air without worrying about sun exposure.

🌞Emergency Hurricane Supplies🌞 - Our solar fan, allowing you to charge your phone, laptop, or flashlight in emergencies. Stay connected and powered up, even in the wilderness. Perfect for camping, hiking, fishing, or even backyard BBQs!

🌞Durable & Anti-Drop Design🌞 - Built to withstand the rigors of outdoor adventures, the solar powered fan’s sturdy ABS housing is shockproof and anti-drop. Whether you’re using it in a tent, by the campfire, or indoors as a desk fan, it’s designed to last. Plus, its cool punk-style design makes it a stylish addition to any space.
